feeds.title: Holland Bloorview Blog
feeds.description: Holland Bloorview is a Kids Rehabilitation Hospital that delivers outstanding personalized, inter-professional care; maximizes function through cutting-edge treatment and technology; co-creates groundbreaking research, innovation, and teaching; connects the system; and drives social justice for children and youth with disabilities. BLOOM Blog combines real family stories with the best expert advice, plus the latest news and opinion on disability.

feeds.title: Special Needs Jungle
feeds.description: Special Needs Jungle provides parent-centred information, news, special needs resources and informed opinion about SEND - Special education needs and disability, Education, Health and Care Plans, children's physical and mental health including rare disease and SEN politics.

feeds.title: Parenting Special Needs
feeds.description: Online Magazine Serving the Special Needs Community. Providing practical tips, sharing life's lessons, tackling the challenges and celebrating the joys of one of life's greatest gifts.

feeds.title: Finding Cooper's Voice
feeds.description: My name is Kate and I am the mama to two wild and crazy boys, Sawyer (age 4) and Cooper (age 6). Cooper has severe, non-verbal autism. As you can imagine, raising a child with a disability has impacted my life in every way possible. I invite you to take a glimpse inside the secret world of Autism. It is sad, funny, scary and heartbreaking. And most of all full of hope and love.

feeds.title: Different By Design Learning
feeds.description: In this blog, Shawna writes about special needs, homeschooling and the messiness of motherhood. Different By Design Learning helps you feel a little lighter, more encouraged, and determined to live with hope.

feeds.title: Smart Kids with Learning Disabilities Blog
feeds.description: Smart Kids with Learning Disabilities is a non-profit organization to educate, guide and inspire families of children with learning disabilities or ADHD and to change the perception of learning disabilities as a stigmatizing condition.

feeds.title: Have Wheelchair Will Travel Blog
feeds.description: At Have Wheelchair Will Travel, this family shares their travel adventures, tips, and day-to-day experiences. Recognizing travel as an occasional indulgence, they offer insights and fun tidbits beyond travel, catering to a diverse audience seeking inspiration and practical advice.

feeds.title: Special Needs Alliance Blog
feeds.description: The mission of the SNA is to maintain a professional organization of attorneys skilled in the complex areas of public entitlements, estate, trust and tax planning, and legal issues involving individuals with physical and cognitive disabilities.

feeds.title: The Sped Guru
feeds.description: Visit SpedGuru.com for relevant information on helping children with and without learning disabilities. Founder Shannon Colclough has experience teaching in various child care settings such as in-home, churches, organizations, and child care centers. She's also taught and volunteered in South Carolina and North Carolina public schools.

feeds.title: My Lovable Pest
feeds.description: Two dads finding hope, humor & heart in their journey of raising a 5-year-old with great potential & prognosis of at-risk FASD. Follow My Blog Get new content delivered directly to your inbox.

feeds.title: Little Puddins
feeds.description: Welcome to Little Puddins. This is my personal blog, which focuses on Family, Parenting, Autism, Special Needs, Craft, and Lifestyle.

feeds.title: Wonders Within Reach Blog
feeds.description: Hi, friends! I'm Jennifer Allen, Mom to two toddlers and a kindergartener, and wife to one youth pastor. Exploring, expanding my world view, understanding different cultures, and learning through experience are all fuels to my personal fire, and now they shape the way I parent and teach my children.

feeds.title: Child Bright Network Blog
feeds.description: Child Bright Network is an innovative pan-Canadian network that aims to improve the life of children with brain-based developmental disabilities and their families. Using child and family focused approaches, they work to create novel interventions to optimize development, promote health outcomes and deliver responsive and supportive services.

feeds.title: eSpecially Ben
feeds.description: This blog is about the journey through the world of a 'special needs child.' They try to give hope by sharing their experiences which can help other families who may be in the same situation.

feeds.title: Joni & Friends Blog
feeds.description: Joni and Friends is dedicated to extending the love and message of Jesus Christ to people who are affected by disability around the world.

feeds.title: Vickie's Views Blog
feeds.description: Short blogs that are Heartwarming, Inspirational, and Funny. Check out topics about everyday life, family, marriage, navigating the world of COVID-19, and raising a child with a disability.

feeds.title: Different Dream Living Blog
feeds.description: Jolene Philo is a published author, speaker, wife and mother of a son with special needs. This blog is for parents of children with special needs who need encouragement and comfort.

feeds.title: Atypical Familia
feeds.description: Atypical Familia (formerly Autismwonderland) is a personal blog that focuses on autism parenting, family travel, working mom life & more.

feeds.title: Downs Side Up
feeds.description: Award-winning Down's syndrome blog.Gently changing perceptions of Down's Syndrome from within hearts. Down's Syndrome Support. Natty is a model with Down's Syndrome.Gently Change Perceptions of Down's Syndrome from Within Hearts:Inspire, Love, Change, Campaign, Educate, Lead, Support.

feeds.title: Tiptoeing Through
feeds.description: Julie has created this blog as a place to share some of her thoughts and feelings about life, love and the unexpected journey of raising a child with special needs.

feeds.title: To Infinity And A Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Blog Command where you will find everything Disney and beyond. Helping you make the most magical memories.

feeds.title: Elisabeth's Story
feeds.description: When the milestones, the charts, and the sequence in development are not there for our children, parents and caregivers like us set out on our own pathway. Elisabeth's story is about searching for a X factor. The X factor that her family, doctors, specialists, and teachers discovered only in hindsight beginning with that emotional bond and fleeting but tangible smile to mean 'yes' and a flinch in eyebrows to mean 'no.'

feeds.title: My CVI Journey
feeds.description: Get tips and ideas for helping your child with Cortical Visual Impairment (CVI) improve their vision. A blog based on our daughter's ongoing journey with CVI.

feeds.title: Our story, our journey.....
feeds.description: I am happily married and the proud mommy of two beautiful boys, I live in Pretoria, South Africa. My oldest son has many health challenges, at this stage we do not have a conclusive diagnosis, we suspect FG Syndrome or mitochondrial disease. I love both my sons equally and am very proud of both of them.

feeds.title: Taking it Day by Day with Developmental Delays (and Autism)
feeds.description: This blog is about a special needs son and what it has been like to raise him, because it is therapeutic, it helps others to not feel alone and helps them to get answers on how to help their child.

feeds.title: ScarredJoy
feeds.description: Scarred Joy's focus is a voice primarily for parents and grandparents raising and loving their children who live with special needs. The challenges these families live with include autism, cerebral palsy, epilepsy, Down syndrome, and the death of a child, etc.

feeds.title: Sher Shares
feeds.description: A journey in Special Needs Parenting for families dealing with special/medical needs and disabilities.

feeds.title: Beyond Special
feeds.description: Mission is to help other parents raising children on the spectrum discover the special gifts of their kids too.

feeds.title: Live Better | Moms of Kids with Special Needs
feeds.description: Live Better is a blog for Moms of Kids with Special Needs where Kara shares her daily struggles and happiness with her kids and gives encouragement for faith and life as a special needs mom.

feeds.title: My Kid Loves Broccoli
feeds.description: A blog about life with Hannah who has a rare genetic syndrome, autism and other stuff.

feeds.title: See The Seitz
feeds.description: Dan Seitz and his wife shares deeper thoughts, topics and ideas around living life as special needs parents. Their goal is to create hope, empowerment and confidence in families who are in the first few years of a diagnosis and turn them into lifelong Hopesters

feeds.title: Sara Clime
feeds.description: A special needs mom who wants to walk this crazy-yet-beautiful path with you; claiming joy and purpose, refusing to let the diagnosis define life!

feeds.title: A Very Bright Life Blog
feeds.description: Advice about special needs parenting and silly stories about family life in general. Have kids? Then you can probably relate. I write about parenthood and the challenges and triumphs of parenting a child with a disability.

feeds.title: Made for Movement Blog
feeds.description: This blog was developed to give advice on how to handle different aspects of having a child with disability.

feeds.title: Love That Max
feeds.description: Love That Max is a blog about kids with disabilities, blogs for parents of kids with special needs, parenting special needs, kids with cerebral palsy, kids with developmental delays, cerebral palsy bloggers, developmental delays.

feeds.title: IIAHP Blog
feeds.description: IIAHP is the best therapy center in chd for Autism, ADHD, Cerebral palsy, Down Syndrome etc. We Provide best child speech therepy and other therapies under one Roof.

feeds.title: Noah's Dad
feeds.description: This blog provides the story through their daily one minute read about their son who was born with Down syndrome. Here, they share facts, information, therapy resources, and lots more.

feeds.title: Unbreakable Sara
feeds.description: I started this blog initially for those parents who found themselves in the world of special needs parenting to offer support and experiences of my own journey. Then after doing that for a few months, my own path has changed course and I wanted to share all life experiences. Special needs parenting is hard. Let's build each other up and offer support. You don't know how strong you are until strength is all you have left.

feeds.title: Mozeying Along
feeds.description: Reflections on living in partnership with our children so that we can grow into the best version of ourselves.

feeds.title: POAC Autism Services Blog
feeds.description: POAC is making lives better every day by providing hundreds of free events and trainings for the autism community every year. It is dedicated to helping children and adults with autism achieve their fullest potential by providing quality education, support and recreation at no cost to participants.
